name: The Chess Club
description: Regulars at the chess club each swear by a different opening, a favourite tactic, and a prized set. Work out who plays what.
clues: Either 1420 does not go with Caro-Kann or 1520 goes with French (but not both) if and only if at least one of Boris goes with 1420, Garry goes with 1220, or Benoni goes with Garry.
